researchPapers.title: Explainable Multi-Label Brain CT Findings Detection and Report Generation Using Vision-Language Learning
researchPapers.venue: IEEE International Conference on Bioinformatics and Biomedicine (BIBM 2026 / Under Review)
researchPapers.abstract: We propose an end-to-end explainable vision-language diagnostic framework for multi-label cranial CT scans. Combining 3D slice attention networks with a cross-modal transformer decoder, the model detects acute hemorrhages, ischemic changes, and skull fractures while generating human-readable radiology findings alongside visual Grad-CAM attribution heatmaps.
researchPapers.citation: Billah, A. et al. (2026). Explainable Multi-Label Brain CT Findings Detection and Report Generation Using Vision-Language Learning. IEEE BIBM.
